svg.title: ANCHOR Gym System Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: Editable database model preview with fourteen entities, logical relationships, and cardinality labels.
svg.text: Logical ERD • PostgreSQL application schema • Relationship constraints verified only where backend DDL explicitly declares them
Legend: PK = primary key; PK* = logical key not verified in catalog; FK = key reference; FK† = application reference, physical FK not verified.
Connector labels show parent : child cardinality (1 = exactly one, 0..1 = optional one, 0..M = optional many). Attendance member/guest rows are intended to be mutually exclusive (XOR).
Application approval checks for duplicate application payments; database uniqueness is unverified. Physical FKs are confirmed only for the four auth/token links declared in backend setup.
